title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: controlling the Summary system part.
summary: Business Central version 27 introduces a controllable Summary system part for Copilot that developers can show, hide, or configure on card and document pages. The Summary FactBox uses AI to generate role-tailored record summaries and identify urgent information across the current page and related data.
key_points: Version 26 added the Summary FactBox but it couldn't be controlled; version 27 makes it configurable
The Summary part uses Copilot to generate role-tailored summaries and identify urgent and important information
Developers can control the Summary part using the DefaultSummaryPart identifier on Card, Document, and ListPlus pages
Only one Summary system part is allowed per page, and it cannot be added to List pages

quotes.text: You can only have one Summary system part per page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important constraint developers must know when designing pages with the Summary part
